models.name: Spatial Frequency Analyzer v1
models.description: Analyzes the frequency domain (DFT/DCT) of an image to spot anomalies common in GAN and Diffusion-generated outputs. Sensitive to high-frequency artifacts (spectral peaks) introduced during image synthesis.

models.name: Optical Flow Coherence Engine
models.description: Calculates optical flow vectors between frames. Highly effective against generative video models like Sora and Runway Gen-3 which often produce unnaturally smooth or disjointed micro-movements.

models.name: Micro-Pattern Breathing Detector
models.description: Examines temporal micro-patterns such as inhalation, exhalation, and micro-pauses commonly missed or synthesized poorly by modern TTS systems (VALL-E, ElevenLabs).

models.name: Stylometric N-gram Analyzer
models.description: Uses syntactical parsing and n-gram analysis to identify repetitive stylistic choices and vocabulary combinations preferred by LLM architectures.
